answer: An agent economy can suppress Sybil attacks by enforcing time-locked collateral deposits verified on each consensus pulse. Each entity must lock tokens in escrow, incurring a verifiable cost in capital liquidity across an unbonding horizon per identity. Protocols automatically slash these deposits upon detecting duplicate or malicious actions. However, high financial barriers relegate low-budget agents to an economic tundra, and affluent adversaries can still afford the required stake.
